subject: StoreX private offer: SKU packaging and reseller margin pass-through
messages:
From: Jared Kim <jared.kim@storix.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: lisa.park@velocitytech.com
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer for Reserved ND24 — reseller margin question

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Storix is close to a decision; procurement asked whether the private offer can be structured so our reseller (VelocityTech) can take a commission on the AWS private offer line items. They want a simple pass-through so VelocityTech gets 10% of the net list for the reserved ND24 SKU.

Can you confirm if Redwood supports reseller margin pass-through on marketplace private offers, and whether that changes the gross discount we need to offer Storix? We’re also evaluating a 20% upfront discount on the reserved SKU vs a blended usage credit approach.

We attached a rough procurement timeline — target signature by 6/08.

Regards,
Jared
Head of Cloud Procurement, Storix

Attachment: storix_timeline_20260517.xlsx (procurement timeline)
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@storix.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for Reserved ND24 — reseller margin question

Jared —

Short answer: yes, we can structure the private offer so that VelocityTech receives a commission, but there are two straightforward approaches and slightly different operational/financial trade-offs:

1) Marketplace pass-through (recommended): Redwood issues the private offer with the reserved ND24 SKU. VelocityTech is added as the reseller/payee in the marketplace flow and their 10% is taken as a commission at payout. This keeps Storix’s list price and the private offer intact; Redwood’s net revenue is reduced by the commission.

2) Netting via discount: Redwood increases the headline discount to Storix and pays VelocityTech their 10% from Redwood’s net. This is simpler from marketplace accounting but changes how discounts are represented on the procurement paperwork.

Operational notes: the marketplace pass-through requires VelocityTech to be a registered reseller in the same marketplace account and will need an invoice routing form. If you prefer option 1 we’ll need their reseller ID and contact for ops.

I’m looping in Irene (channel ops) and Naomi (pricing) to confirm exact margin handling and whether we can absorb the commission within the current discount bucket or if this has to reduce Redwood margin explicitly.

I’ll attach a draft private offer doc and the SKU mapping for the reserved ND24 SKU for reference.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: storix_privoffer_draft_20260518.pdf, sku_map_rwd_reserved_nd24.csv
From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for Reserved ND24 — reseller margin question

Ben / Naomi —

We can support marketplace pass-through for VelocityTech provided these conditions are met:
- VelocityTech must be a registered AWS reseller with the correct seller/reseller ID associated to the private offer.
- Marketplace invoicing must route to Redwood; Redwood will record a payee split and pay VelocityTech their 10% commission during settlement.
- For GCP/Azure similar mechanics exist but require reseller enrollment; timelines vary.

Naomi — is a 10% commission feasible within the current discount bucket for this deal? If not, propose the adjusted headline discount (we will need the delta so Ben can communicate to Storix).

Also flagged to Finance: we’ll need a short reseller routing form filled by VelocityTech before DocuSign.

— Irene
Director, Channel Operations

Attachment: reseller_routing_form_template.pdf (ops form)
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for Reserved ND24 — reseller margin question

Team —

I ran the numbers. If VelocityTech takes a 10% commission from the gross private offer value, Redwood net margin drops ~11.2% on the reserved ND24 line assuming the current list-to-net waterfall (list -> partner rebate -> Redwood discount). Two practical ways to make the math work for us and Storix:

A) Keep headline discount for Storix at 20% but Redwood absorbs the commission out of margin (we accept the margin hit). This is simplest for procurement but reduces Redwood net.

B) Increase the headline discount offered to Storix to effectively back out the commission so Redwood net is unchanged. For 10% commission we’d need to increase the headline discount to ~24.5% (rough estimate; exact number depends on tax/tiering).

Recommendation: offer option A as a limited early-adopter concession for Storix with a 12-month commitment, or go with option B if Storix can’t accept any margin erosion. Ben — let me know which option you think will close faster.

Naomi
Director, Revenue Strategy

Attachment: sku_map_rwd_reserved_nd24.csv (updated with margin calc column)
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@storix.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@velocitytech.com>, irene.choi@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-22T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for Reserved ND24 — reseller margin question

Jared / Lisa —

Thanks — quick update after internal alignment:

1) We can do marketplace pass-through (option 1). For Storix we propose two paths to finalize:
   - Path A (preferred for speed): Headline 20% discount, Redwood absorbs VelocityTech 10% commission as an early-adopter concession tied to a 12-month minimum commit. This lets procurement finish without extra paperwork beyond the reseller routing form.
   - Path B (if procurement pushes back): Increase headline discount to 24.5% so VelocityTech gets its 10% commission but Redwood’s net revenue is preserved.
2) Next steps we need from VelocityTech: reseller ID, AP contact, and signed reseller routing form (Irene attached a template).
3) I’ll update the DocuSign private offer for Path A and send a link by EOD Tuesday; if you want Path B instead let me know today and we’ll update pricing before DocuSign.

If you want, we can also split the difference (18% + 4% usage credit) but that tends to slow procurement.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Tel: +1 (415) 555-0124
